Description: TVS diode 18V BIDIRECTIONAL — WHITE rail transient clamp
Notes: On WHITE (+12-16V) rail. CA suffix essential (bidirectional). Separate from D_PG pass gate on BLACK line.

Description: Pass gate on BLACK controller path — zero-drop active switch
Notes: Prototype: NPN level-shift (2T+3R). Production: LTC4412 ideal diode IC. Isolates controller from track during brake takeover.
100V reverse rating required — inductive turn-off spike on 16V rail. SS34 (40V) has insufficient margin

Description: Schottky 3A 60V (MBRS360) or 5A 40V (SS54) — mode C series protection
Notes: ESSENTIAL for mode C. Sees repetitive ~46A pulses at 20kHz during hard braking. SS34 marginal under repetitive stress. MBRS360 same footprint.
Place as close to VDD pin as possible
Place as close to VDDA pin as possible

Description: GD2 input pull-up — safe default brake
Notes: Placed BEFORE GD2 input — not on Q2 gate
